releaseNotes:
v2.30.3 — UI fixes & VIP improvements
• Fix: level number no longer flashes ‘1’ before showing correct level
• Fix: future themed packs are now locked until their season begins
• VIP: 2× rewards on themed pack milestones (every 10 levels)
• VIP: 2× grand prize when completing all 100 levels of a themed pack
• VIP: 2× diamonds for completing every 10-level stage
• About: version number updated to 2.30.3
